title: Condensed local Frobenius trace is invariant under one Frobenius translate
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $k$ be a field of positive prime characteristic $p\ne\ell$, put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $\underline\Omega=\operatorname{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$ and $\mathcal D_T=D^b_c(T)[[\underline\Omega]]$ for $T=X,s$, with coefficient pullback, module-object derived pullbacks and tensor products [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible, def-sfb-dc-upper-star, def-sfb-dc-tensor]. Let $\Psi:X\to X$ be any $k$-endomorphism and let $M\in\mathcal D_X$ have an isomorphism $\psi:L\Psi^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}M$. Define $\psi_0$ by identity pullback and $\psi_{r+1}=\psi\circ L\Psi^*(\psi_r)$ using the canonical identity and pullback-composition comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-point-pullback], so $\psi_r:L(\Psi^r)^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}M$. Fix $m\geq0$ and a $k$-point $z:s\to X$ with $\Psi^m z=z$. For any $\Psi^m$-fixed point $t$, define $V_{t,m}:Lt^*M\to Lt^*M$ as the canonical fixed-point pullback identification $Lt^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}Lt^*L(\Psi^m)^*M$ followed by $Lt^*(\psi_m)$; these are the stalkFrobenius operators. Then $\Psi z$ is also fixed by $\Psi^m$. If $Lz^*M$ and $L(\Psi z)^*M$ have right duals in $\mathcal D_s$, their categorical traces [sk-d-trace] satisfy
$$\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal D_s}(V_{\Psi z,m})=\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal D_s}(V_{z,m})\quad\text{in }\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal D_s}(U_s),$$
where $U_s$ is the coefficient unit. No finite-field model, finite fixed-point set, integral lattice, or global trace identity is assumed.
